cases.name: custom-write-result
cases.source:
import csv
events=[]
class Sink:
 def write(self,text):
  events.append(text)
  return 'saved'
writer=csv.writer(Sink(),lineterminator='\n')
print(writer.writerow(['a','b']))
print(events)

receiver-before-argument
cases.source:
import csv,io
sink=io.StringIO()
other_sink=io.StringIO()
writer=csv.writer(sink,lineterminator='\n')
other=csv.writer(other_sink,lineterminator='\n')
def argument():
 global writer
 writer=other
 return ['a','b']
print(writer.writerow(argument()))
print(repr(sink.getvalue()),repr(other_sink.getvalue()))
